node.description:
__Place of Birth:__ Rim Billiton
__Race:__ Cautus/Chimera
__Height:__ 142 cm

The public face of Rhodes Island and its top executive. Although Amiya appears to be a young and inexperienced girl, she is universally trusted and highly qualified for her position. Amiya now leads Rhodes Island in fighting for the future of the Infected and striving to exorcise the dark shadow of Originium from the land.

~!Amiya is the current holder of Civilight Eterna making her the successor of the previous "King of Sarkaz", [Theresa](https://anilist.co/character/300731/Theresa) who died in an assassination during the previous Sarkaz Civil War. She is also believed to be the "Lord of Fiends" a prophesized legend who will bring the apocalypse and the end of Terra.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Lupo
__Height:__ 161 cm

Texas is a Penguin Logistics staff member who is extraordinarily skilled in single combat. She was sent to Rhodes Island as a liaison, where she assists with a variety of operations.

__Birthday:__  Claims to have forgotten
__Place of Birth:__ Kazdel
__Race:__ Sarkaz
__Height:__ 165 cm

W, Sarkaz mercenary leader. W's squad, having been involved in Kazdel's lengthy civil war, is infamous for their brutal and efficient combat methods. W clashed with Rhodes Island during the Chernobog incident, but after defecting from Reunion for unknown reasons, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island after negotiating with [Dr. Kal'tsit](https://anilist.co/character/174803/Kaltsit) in person.

__Birthday:__ Undisclosed
__Place of Birth:__ Rhodes Island
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 169 cm

Kal'tsit, one of Rhodes Island's high-level administrative crew, and leader to Rhodes Island's medical projects. Profoundly learned in metallurgy, sociology, Originium Arts, archaeology, history and genealogy, economics, botany, geology, and other fields. In a portion of Rhodes Island operations, provides medical theory assistance and emergency aid apparatus as medical personnel. Simultaneously, active in many projects as a major constituent of Rhodes Island's command system.

Kal'tsit has the ability to summon Mont3r, a biomechanical entity that seemingly comes out of her spine and is used for self-defense and in combat.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Lung
__Height:__ 168 cm

Ch'en, head of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Royal Victorian Guard School with superb grades and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals. Now works at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command.

~!An Infected and the niece to [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Yenwu-Wei), the regional leader of Yen-Lungmen. She has shown an aptitude for Originium Arts although she has a terrible control over it. But it is implied that using a sword as the conduit to her Arts gives her greater control over her Arts.!~

~!She is the half-sister of the Reunion Movement Leader, [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah).!~

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus
__Race:__ Cautus

A Cautus Infected, born to a life of slave-mining in the Ursus tundra, FrostNova is a high-ranking member of Reunion. She leads the fearsome Yeti Squadron for special operations and is one of the few Casters who can suppress enemies in a head-on engagement. Saved by [Patriot](https://anilist.co/character/265827/Patriot) from her horrific life, FrostNova looks up to him as her father.

~!Sent by [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah) to attack Lungmen in coalition with Mephisto, they are held off by the combined efforts of Rhodes Island and Lungmen Guard Department before the Black Raincoats sweep in and lead a purge of the Lungmen Infected. With their roles now reversed, FrostNova stays back to help evacuate the slums even as her Oripathy worsens. She eventually confronts [Doctor](https://anilist.co/character/182729/Doctor) and [Amiya](https://anilist.co/character/174801/Amiya) who offer her a chance to join Rhodes Island. FrostNova agrees on the condition they beat her, on pretext of testing Amiya's resolve to defeat Talulah.!~

~!Following their fateful encounter, the Doctor takes FrostNova's body with them so she could be properly cremated in one of Rhodes Island's incineration chambers as a sign of their honour and respect towards her, now a posthumous member of Rhodes Island.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Laterano
__Race:__ Sankta
__Height:__ 159 cm

Exusiai is a citizen of Laterano and as such, is entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1-13 of the Laterano Constitution. She is an employee of Penguin Logistics who specializes in covert communication, armed escort, and other undercover activities. We suspect she is a Messenger. While contracted with Penguin Logistics, she serves as a liaison to Rhodes Island, assisting us with our operations.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen, Yan
__Race:__ Draco
__Height:__ 178 cm

Talulah is the leader of the rebel group Reunion, intent on destroying those who oppress the infected. With her striking appearance, including long silver hair and red eyes, Talulah exudes elegance and fierceness. She wields a powerful scythe-like blade called the Fallen Sword and displays exceptional combat skills, utilizing Originium manipulation to unleash devastating flames.

~!Talulah and [Ch'en](https://anilist.co/character/174797/Chen) are half-sisters as they have the same mother, [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Wei-Yenwu)'s sister.!~

~!Talulah was kidnapped and trained by Duke Kashchey. She killed him shortly after escaping, but ended up being "corrupted" by him through an ancient arts.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Higashi
__Race:__ Oni
__Height:__ 184 cm

Hoshiguma is an elite Operator from the Special Ops Team of the L.G.D. There are several charges against her on record. After intervention from Chief Wei Yenwu, L.G.D. made an exception to admit her into its Special Ops division based on her exceptional abilities and field performance. She exhibited remarkable professionalism in handling violent crime, protecting VIPs, disaster response and emergency rescue. Currently a defender assisting Rhodes Island operations, Hoshiguma provides tactical execution and command support.

__Age:__ ~!>13,000!~

Almost nothing is known about the Doctor's background and past, other than that they had a doctorate in neurology and had extensively researched Oripathy prior to the events of the story. Like Kal'tsit, their file number starts with 'B', implying a connection to Babel, the predecessor of Rhodes Island.

Currently suffering from amnesia, the Doctor was rescued by Amiya from Chernobog when Talulah led the Reunion insurgence against the Ursus empire.

~!Doctor belongs to an extinct race called "First Civilization", a space-faring civilization who colonized Terra, bringing with them animals who later evolves into the Ancients and Elders.!~

__Birthday:__ Undisclosed
__Place of Birth:__ Victoria
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 172 cm

Blaze, an elite Rhodes Island Operator, has demonstrated professional combat skills and tactical decisionmaking in mobile operations, annihilation, and raids. Now commanded by Amiya, she is a staple for when battles get tough.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 142cm

Rhodes Island Elite Operator Rosmontis possesses a high aptitude for a rare form of Originium Arts particularly adept at confronting large creatures, destroying hard objectives, immobilizing facilities under emergency, and putting a stop to small-scale skirmishes. She has been shown to possess a solid control of the battlefield and considerable tactical value in assault, positional, and annihilation scenarios. Under Kal'tsit's assignment, she is currently active as a core annihilation specialist.

__Place of Birth:__ Vouivre
__Race:__ Vouivre
__Height:__ 156 cm

Liskarm is an employee of Blacksteel Worldwide, a private security contractor that provides security and protection services to international business, state agencies and non-governmental organizations. She has a lot of combat experience in conflict zones. Liskarm is currently under contract to provide professional security and other consulting services to Rhodes Island.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Vulpo
__Height:__ 163 cm

Franka, biohazard protection and response specialist for Blacksteel Worldwide, is very experienced and proficient in VIP protection, raid, and combat support operations. She is currently undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island and providing professional security as a Blacksteel Operator.

alternative: ジェシカ・ブリンリー

node.description:
__Place of Birth:__ Victoria
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 147 cm

A fully enlisted Operator coming from a private security firm based in Columbia. Blacksteel Worldwide, currently stationed at Rhodes Island as part of an exchange training program. A timid person, she often ends up as a test subject for whatever new equipment Blacksteel are researching because she wouldn't reject the offer made by the executives. Her timidity is the result of her selective perception that causes insecurities. In fact, she is a very capable Operator with no flaws in her operation records.

The weapon she uses, a Blacksteel-made Originium gun, is very expensive to maintain due to it using Originium rounds as ammunition, a valuable crystalline substance used in all of Terra. It is noted by her fellow Operator that she foots the bill using her personal snack money to buy the ammunition for the gun.

Patriot is a high-ranking member of the Reunion movement. He was born over 200 years ago and is the last pureblood Wendigo Sarkaz. His armor is in disrepair and damaged in many places. The blade of his once sharp halberd is now eroded with rust. However, the indomitable Patriot never capitulates, never backs down, and never shows mercy. He has long struggled with fate, and now resolves to slit the throat of fate.

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia
__Race:__ Vulpo

Frostleaf is a former Columbian Junior Army soldier, 'retired' after her unit was destroyed. Came into contact with Rhodes Island later as a mercenary, before officially joining following a period of collaboration with the company. With extensive combat experience and undeniably skilled, Frostleaf is an excellent asset to Rhodes Island.

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus
__Race:__ Phidia
__Height:__ 164 cm

A Sniper who is one of Reunion's squad leaders, often working in tandem with [Mephisto](https://anilist.co/character/274330/Mephisto). He uses extremely long-range attacks to inflict devastating physical damage. He is known to occasionally use special attacks such as summoning turret-like ballistae or launching highly destructive bolts.

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Feline
__Height:__ 163 cm

Swire, Senior Superintendent of the Lungmen Guard Department. Now a special attache at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command.

__Birthplace:__ Ursus

One of Reunion's squad leaders who handles infiltration and assassination operations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. Her stealth and superb infiltration abilities have foiled countless attempts to capture her.

Projekt Red's real identity is unknown and her background a mystery. She was taken in, raised, and protected by [Dr. Kal'tsit](https://anilist.co/character/174803/Kaltsit). 

Extremely talented in high mobility warfare, special ops and stealth combat. Projekt Red now serves as a Specialist Operator for Rhodes Island under Dr. Kal'tsit's guidance.

Ace is a Rhodes Island elite operator that plays a supporting role in the Prologue and Episode 01. Due to his actions Amiya, the Doctor, and the remainder of the Rhodes Island units were able to escape from Chernobog, letting the mission for Doctor's rescue succeed. ~!In the attempt to buy time for Amiya he was slain by Talulah.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Lungmen
__Race:__ Zalak
__Height:__ 166 cm

Lin Yühsia is a character who plays a role in Chapter 06 of the main story and Dossoles Holiday. She has the ability to convert sand into glass as well as controlling glass products.

She is the only daughter of Rat King, the undisputed godfather of Lungman's underworld. Although she would be his successor, she has not decided to take her father's place yet.

__Place of Birth:__ Undisclosed
__Race:__ Liberi
__Height:__ 162 cm

Operator GreyThroat, despite only receiving her codename recently, has actually been part of Rhodes Island for much longer than the time she's served as an Operator. Her parents were formerly Oripathy researchers who traveled around. Her mother entrusted GreyThroat to Rhodes Island before disappearing. Now, she has passed the Operator assessment and is a member of Rhodes Island's operation team.

__Place of Birth:__  Kazdel
__Race:__ Sarkaz
__Height:__ 170cm

Formerly a member of Firewatch's group, she is now a freelance mercenary. Other details of her history are unknown. Now serving as a sniper Operator for Rhodes Island, she uses the bowgun in her hands to exert lethality from afar.

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus

One of Reunion's squad leaders, often working in tandem with [Faust](https://anilist.co/character/192958/Faust). 

Currently, it has been confirmed that he is the one controlling the Hosts. He heals the wounded while commanding his troops to attack.

__Place of Birth:__ Baizao, Yan
__Race:__ Lung
__Height:__ 191cm

Wei Yenwu is the chief executive and leader of Lungmen and the husband of Fumizuki. He is a shrewd businessman and politician who managed to make Lungmen a prosperous and wealthy mobile city under his administration. Wei is a talented man in martial arts. He is famous for his mastery of swordsmanship through his Chi Xiao, the legendary dragon-slaying sword meant to slay monarchs in Yanese folklore.

__Place of Birth:__ Yan
__Race:__ Kylin
__Height:__ 171 cm

Leizi, an official from Yan's Central Judicial Office, is temporarily residing in Rhodes Island after signing an investigation agreement. Well-trained in combat skills and possessing unique Originium Arts, Leizi excels in annihilation battles and positional warfare. However, because of her noteworthy background and ambiguous motives, it is recommended to err on the side of a passive, non-cooperative tone when communicating with her.

Nine was Ch'en's senior in the Lungmen Guard Department. However, three years ago, both contacted Oripathy by Originium bombs during a mission. The illness caused her to isolate herself from the L.G.D. and she had not been attending their operations. Even though Ch'en had persuaded her to remain in her position as the L.G.D. can help her conceal her situation, Nine refused, thinking that it would be an act of corruption.

Nine also possesses the ability to control herbal toxins by summoning poisonous plants through her Arts.

(Source: Arknights Wikia, edited)
PRTS is an artificial intelligence (A.I.) that assists the amnesiac Doctor with reacquainting themselves to Rhodes Island's facilities after their rescue from Chernobog.

name.native: ケイリーンフォールズ

node.description:
__Place of Birth:__ Kazdel
__Race:__ Sarkaz

Little is known about Scout, other than he is one of those who fought for Theresa during the Kazdel civil war as part of Babel. When Babel transitioned into Rhodes Island, Scout remained with them and became one of R.I.'s elite operatives, sharing a strong camaraderie with fellow elites Ace, Blaze, and Rosmontis. During the Chernobog incident, he led a squad of twelve operators to defeat the leader of a Sarkaz mercenary.

~!He managed to escape with the annihilation of his entire squad before his ultimate death.!~

(Source: Arknights Wiki, edited)

__Place of Birth:__ Higashi
__Race:__ Lung

Wife of Lungmen leader [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Yenwu-Wei). Originally a princess of the Far East, she moved with Wei to Lungmen. Appears dainty and weak, but she is actually skilled in the use of Originium powers and has tremendous political acumen. She acts sweet and delicate but is actually quite a visionary. She is her husband's most steadfast supporter.

__Place of Birth:__ Yan
__Race:__ Forte

Taihe is the current Vice Minister of the Department of Discipline and Supervision and a superior for Leizi. He also seems to have connection with the Sui Regulator where he serves as the bodyguard for the young Candleholder Zuo Le.

(Source: Arknights Wikia)

__Place of Birth:__ Lugmen
__Race:__ Oni

Phal was a member of Hoshiguma's street gang in Lungmen who befriended her ten years ago. After Hoshiguma became an officer in the Lungmen Guard Department, Phal has been working as a bartender until he contracted Oripathy a year ago.

(Source: Arknights Wiki, edited)

__Place of Birth:__ Yan

Nothing is known about Jiezhen other than him being a Censor of Yan's Department of Discipline and Supervision and a superior for Leizi. He looks down on the Infected and appears to be related in some way to Blaze's father.
